mapper.select: SELECT currency_code, currency_name, symbol, unit FROM currencies WHERE currency_code != 'KRW' ORDER BY currency_code

SELECT er.deal_base_rate FROM exchange_rates er INNER JOIN currencies c ON c.id = er.target_currency_id WHERE c.currency_code = #{currencyCode} ORDER BY er.rate_date DESC, er.created_at DESC, er.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, wallet_id, travel_card_id, card_name, issuer_name, masked_card_number, status, linked_at, unlinked_at FROM wallet_travel_card WHERE wallet_id = #{walletId} AND id = #{walletTravelCardId} AND status = 'LINKED' FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, wallet_travel_card_id, currency_code, balance_amount, krw_estimated_amount, updated_at FROM travel_card_balance WHERE wallet_travel_card_id = #{walletTravelCardId} AND currency_code = #{currencyCode} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE travel_card_balance SET balance_amount = #{balanceAmount}, krw_estimated_amount = #{krwEstimatedAmount}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{balanceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO travel_card_ledger ( wallet_travel_card_id, currency_code, direction, transaction_type, foreign_amount, balance_before, balance_after, source_type, source_id, target_type, target_id, idempotency_key, memo ) VALUES ( #{walletTravelCardId}, #{currencyCode}, #{direction}, #{transactionType}, #{foreignAmount}, #{balanceBefore}, #{balanceAfter}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{memo} )

INSERT INTO wallet_exchange_transaction ( wallet_id, wallet_travel_card_id, currency_code, exchange_type, krw_amount, foreign_amount, base_exchange_rate, applied_exchange_rate, fee_rate, fee_amount, status, completed_at, wallet_ledger_id, card_ledger_id ) VALUES ( #{walletId}, #{walletTravelCardId}, #{currencyCode}, #{exchangeType}, #{krwAmount}, #{foreignAmount}, #{baseExchangeRate}, #{appliedExchangeRate}, #{feeRate}, #{feeAmount}, #{status}, #{completedAt}, #{walletLedgerId}, #{cardLedgerId} )
